summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear implemented via a new GifSlideshow component and updated ValentineSuccessView that cycles img3.gif/img1.gif and renders the exact required text beneath. REQ-3 appears preserved in ValentinePromptPage with the original question, Yes/No buttons, and progressive Yes scaling on No clicks. Several extra UI elements/messages were added beyond the request.

hallucinated_features.description: Added animated hearts background and decorative Sparkles/Heart icon header on the success screen.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks for a looping GIF slideshow and the exact text beneath it; it does not request additional animated background/decoration.

hallucinated_features.description: Added extra success-screen headline text "I love you" (separate from the required "I love you Himani Chauhan").
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 specifies displaying the text exactly as “I love you Himani Chauhan” beneath the GIF area; an additional large "I love you" headline was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an additional celebratory message "You made the right choice! 💕" on the success screen.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; only the specified text under the GIF slideshow is required.

hallucinated_features.description: Added footer content including “© 2026” and a link to caffeine.ai on the success screen (and prompt page appears to also have a footer).
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement mentions footers, copyright text, or external links.

hallucinated_features.description: Changed prompt-page button labels and added extra prompt-page copy/messages with emojis (e.g., "Yes! 💖", "No 😢", "Choose wisely... 💕", and post-No-click messages).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 only requires preserving the prompt question and Yes/No behavior; these additional texts and emoji embellishments were not requested.
